name: HAIL
author: hundekraft
description: HAIL records what comes in and plays many short, overlapping grains from it: pitched, reversed, smeared and sent into a reverb. It's based on the granular mode of Mutable Instruments Beads, with a buffer of about 1.5 seconds and up to 12 grains at once (8 while the reverb is on).
credits: Port of Mutable Instruments Beads by Émilie Gillet (MIT)
